summary: INNOVATE Corp. filed an 8-K disclosing a Fourth Supplemental Indenture dated October 9, 2026, among the company, subsidiary guarantors and U.S. Bank Trust Company as trustee and collateral trustee, amending the indenture governing its 9.500% Convertible Senior Secured Notes due 2027. The amendment requires redemption of all notes on the 15th business day after the lock-up on the stock consideration from the previously announced DBMG Global Inc. sale terminates, at 100% of principal plus accrued interest, and confirms no repurchase offer is required. The lock-up expires the earlier of December 4, 2026 or effectiveness of the resale registration statement for the DBMG shares. This is a routine indenture amendment tied to a previously disclosed divestiture, not a new special situation; watch redemption timing, the resale registration and the resulting liquidity overhang.
